subject: attn
title: (R)ATTN.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 271 (CMBA-27). ATTN (attraction) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), AFL (affinity alignment) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From AFL: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From AFTD: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). AFI (affinity insight), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from SOC-RT-P. From AFI: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and C-INFO (composite information).
